svg.title: Regional transcriptomic heterogeneity in breast cancer
svg.desc: Author-prepared schematic summary of paired primary breast tumor and regional node transcriptomics, selected independent cellular support and METABRIC nodal-burden context. Anatomical, cellular and expression-profile illustrations are schematic, not primary research images.
